text.lead: Low Life is a 2022 American crime drama thriller film directed by Tyler Michael James.
text.reception: Morgan Keller of SLUG called Low Life "too heavy for a horror movie and too cheesy to be a drama". Film Threat reviewer Alan Ng said the film was "a non-stop rollercoaster that will leave you frazzled long after it's over, just before getting back on the ride".
